practices.title: No swallowed errors
practices.statement: Discarding an error requires an explicit, justified ignore; unexamined error paths are defects.

practices.title: Context at the source
practices.statement: Attach context where the failure is detected, not where it finally surfaces.

practices.title: Classify failures
practices.statement: Separate recoverable from unrecoverable failures and handle each accordingly.

practices.title: Bounded retries
practices.statement: Retries are bounded, back off, and only repeat idempotent operations.
